column1: The Supply of Goods and Services We can now see that the factors of production and the production function together determine the quantity of goods and services supplied, which in turn equals the economy’s output. To express this mathematically, we write Y  F (K – , L – )  Y – . In this chapter, because we assume that the supplies of capital and labor and the technology are fixed, output is also fixed (at a level denoted here as – Y ).
